international.title: Police arrest teacher who missed sentencing after indecent assault conviction
international.summary: Sally-Anne Bowen was found guilty of having sexual relationships with two pupils at a boys’ school in the 1980s A chemistry teacher who had sexual relationships with two pupils at a boys’ school in the late 1980s has been arrested by police in Hampshire after she failed to turn up to her sentencing hearing. Sally-Anne Bowen, 65, could not be found at her home by Metropolitan police officers on Friday morning after a warrant was issued for her arrest, a court heard. Continue reading...
